name: Spectral+NEE MIS (Shadow Connection Routine)
aliases: Spectral Multiple Importance Sampling with Next-Event Estimation
definition: A routine for next-event estimation within the spectral MIS framework, combining unidirectional and next-event path pdfs to estimate light connections in chromatic media.
summary: Spectral+NEE MIS is a shadow connection routine that estimates direct illumination in chromatic media by combining unidirectional path sampling and next-event estimation using ratio tracking to handle null scattering events.
